subtitle: Cook Serve Upgrade Kitchen
promotional_text: Pantry Rush puts you in a busy kitchen. Cook recipes, serve orders, upgrade equipment, and grow your restaurant.
description: Pantry Rush is a casual cooking simulation where you manage a small kitchen, prepare dishes, fulfill customer orders, and upgrade your equipment. Collect recipes, earn coins, expand your menu, and master fast-paced cooking. It includes multiple themes, order management, kitchen upgrades, and a collection system. Easy to learn and satisfying for cooking game fans.
app_review_notes: Pantry Rush is an offline cooking simulation. Players select recipes, cook dishes, serve orders, and upgrade kitchen equipment. No sign-in is required. It is a single-player casual game.
